name: books this year: read_at wins, date_added only when read_at is empty
cell: rest / all sources / never started / base
comment: Effective date = read_at; when read_at is null and books.fallback_to_date_added is true, date_added. A book counts for a day when its effective date is in that day's calendar year and not after the day.
A: read_at 2026-02-01 (date_added 2025-12-01) -> counts (read_at wins; a mutant that uses date_added when read_at exists drops it).
B: read_at null, date_added 2026-05-05 -> counts via the fallback.
C: read_at 2025-11-20, date_added 2026-01-15 -> does not count (read_at exists and is last year; a mutant that counts by date_added adds it).
D: read_at 2026-10-10 = today -> counts on 10-10 and is book_finished_today; not counted on 10-09.
E: read_at null, date_added 2026-11-01 -> after today, not yet counted.
F: read_at '2026-04-02T14:00:00-07:00' (an ISO datetime with an offset) -> its home-timezone date 2026-04-02 counts.
books_ytd on 10-09 = A + B + F = 3; on 10-10 = A + B + F + D = 4; wins on 10-10 = [sleep, book] (7.0 h sleep both days).
